_comment: Copy to config.json if you prefer editing it by hand; the Settings dialog writes the same file. Two sections: `ark` is Volcengine Ark (the two official surfaces, keys not interchangeable), `openai` is any OpenAI-compatible image endpoint. refs_mode decides how reference images travel: json (data URLs in the body — Ark and most relays), multipart (a real /images/edits upload), none.
